defense_news.title: The US Army is looking for new drones to ferry blood supplies
defense_news.summary: As part of the U.S. Army Blood Link project, the service is seeking new drones that can transport blood supplies in the field.

defense_news.title: Lockheed Martin gets first batch of Patriot interceptor parts from General Motors
defense_news.summary: In an "extraordinary" 22-day turnaround, Lockheed Martin received its first shipment of critical components from General Motors for Patriot interceptors.

defense_news.title: US Navy should target carriers in fight with China, report says
defense_news.summary: A U.S. think tank devised a strategy to target Chinese aircraft carriers by using similar tactics that China has planned against American ships.

defense_news.title: Pentagon, Lockheed sign framework deal to boost AIM-260 production
defense_news.summary: The agreement was signed to expand production of the AIM-260 JATM, laying the groundwork for a future multiyear buy of the long-range air-to-air weapon.
